# Yule garland

Type: Furniture | Internal ID: piece_xmasgarland | Source: Workbench | Season: Yule (Christmas) | Usage: Decoration | Crafting Materials: Finewood x2, Pine cone x1 | Weak to (x1.5): Chop | Neutral to (x1): Blunt, ,, Slash, ,, Pickaxe, ,, Fire, ,, Frost, ,, Lightning | Resistant to (x0.5): Pierce | Immune to (x0): Poison, ,, Spirit

# Introduction

Yule garland is a seasonal decorative object. It needs to be built within the range of a Workbench and on a wall or roof.

## Availability

The Yule garland cannot be built year-round. It can only be built during the Christmas season, 1 December – 6 January.

Categorias: Furniture, Seasonal Furniture
